face.name: 光明邪使菲奥拉
face.text: 每当你以本随从为目标施放一个法术时，获得圣盾。
face.flavorText: 她最爱被别人叫“邪使姐妹花”了。

face.name: Fjola Lightbane
face.text: Whenever you target this minion with a spell, gain Divine Shield.
face.flavorText: LOVES being called "the wonder twins".

face.name: 黑暗邪使艾蒂丝
face.text: 每当你以本随从为目标施放一个法术时，随机对一个敌人造成3点伤害。
face.flavorText: 她最恨被别人叫“邪使姐妹花”了。

face.name: Eydis Darkbane
face.text: Whenever you target this minion with a spell, deal 3 damage to a random enemy.
face.flavorText: HATES being called "the wonder twins".

face.name: 大富翁比尔杜
face.text: 在你施放一个法术后，复原你的 英雄技能。
face.flavorText: 加基森的地下拍卖行随着城市的迅猛发展，生意越做越大。比尔杜挣钱后开始涉足房地产行业，并一跃成为加基森数一数二的大富豪。

face.name: Auctionmaster Beardo
face.text: After you cast a spell, refresh your Hero Power.
face.flavorText: Gadgetzan has always run an under-the-table auction house, and business has been PRETTY good for Beardo since the population explosion. And since the explosion that destroyed the competing auction houses in the city.

face.name: 游学者周卓
face.text: 每当一个玩家施放一个法术，复制该法术，将其置入另一个玩家的手牌。
face.flavorText: 游学者周卓整理并分享有关潘达利亚大陆的轶事，但他最喜欢的故事，是乔伊和菲比一起外出旅行发生的事情。

face.name: Lorewalker Cho
face.text: Whenever a player casts a spell, put a copy into the other player’s hand.
face.flavorText: Lorewalker Cho archives and shares tales from the land of Pandaria, but his favorite story is the one where Joey and Phoebe go on a road trip.

face.name: 萨维斯
face.text: 在你使用一张牌后，召唤一个2/1的萨特。
face.flavorText: 萨维斯怀着召唤萨格拉斯的宏伟噩梦，但他现在要从召唤萨特做起。

face.name: Xavius
face.text: After you play a card, summon a 2/1 Satyr.
face.flavorText: Xavius has grand nightmares of summoning Sargeras into this world, but a few Satyr will have to do for now.

face.name: 加里维克斯
face.text: 每当你的对手施放一个法术，获得该法术的复制，并使其获得一张幸运币。
face.flavorText: 供求关系是加里维克斯唯一的信条。只要你给钱，他就提供殴打服务。

face.name: Trade Prince Gallywix
face.text: Whenever your opponent casts a spell, gain a copy of it and give them a Coin.
face.flavorText: Gallywix believes in supply and demand. He supplies the beatings and demands you pay up!

face.name: 颤地者特罗格佐尔
face.text: 每当你的对手施放一个法术，召唤一个石腭穴居人壮汉。
face.flavorText: 他不断震颤着大地，使山脉深处出现了大量洞穴，解决了穴居人的住房问题。

face.name: Troggzor the Earthinator
face.text: Whenever your opponent casts a spell, summon a Burly Rockjaw Trogg.
face.flavorText: He keeps earthinating the countryside despite attempts to stop him.

face.name: 监护者哈尔琳
face.text: 在你施放一个法术后，造成4点伤害，随机分配到所有敌人身上。
face.flavorText: 你会怎样应对奥妮克希亚这种问题少女呢？

face.name: Haleh, Matron Protectorate
face.text: After you cast a spell, deal 4 damage randomly split among all enemies.
face.flavorText: Oh, how do you solve a problem like Onyxia?

face.name: 决斗大师莫扎奇
face.text: 在你施放一个法术后，获得法术伤害+1。
face.flavorText: 对待学生就像对待旗鼓相当的对手，所谓的决斗其实是单方面的碾压。

face.name: Mozaki, Master Duelist
face.text: After you cast a spell, gain Spell Damage +1.
face.flavorText: Treats her students like her peers, which means defeating them in one-sided duels all day long.

face.name: 拉伊·纳兹亚
face.text: 在你施放一个法术后，对敌方英雄造成等同于其法力值消耗的 伤害。
face.flavorText: 当你使用幸运币时，他会造成精神伤害。

face.name: Raj Naz'jan
face.text: After you cast a spell, deal damage equal to its Cost to the enemy Hero.
face.flavorText: When you play the Coin, he deals emotional damage.

face.name: 石腭穴居人壮汉
face.text: 每当你的对手施放一个法术，获得 +2攻击力。
face.flavorText: 他这么壮是因为他每天坚持健康的饮食，并且每个星期都去穴居人健身房进行锻炼。

face.name: Burly Rockjaw Trogg
face.text: Whenever your opponent casts a spell, gain +2 Attack.
face.flavorText: He's burly because he does CrossFit.

face.name: 加里维克斯的幸运币
face.text: 在本回合中，获得一个法力水晶。（不会触发加里维克斯的效果。）

face.name: Gallywix's Coin
face.text: Gain 1 Mana Crystal this turn only. (Won't trigger Gallywix.)

face.name: 先知者沃
face.text: 扰魔。在你施放一个法术后，&发现一张来自过去的自然法术牌。
face.flavorText: 她冥想了两个星期，心无旁骛地探知着宇宙的每一个角落，事无巨细，无所不包。当她从冥想中醒来，口中只吐出了一个声音：“喔。”

face.name: Farseer Wo
face.text: Elusive After you cast a spell,& Discover a Nature spell from the past.
face.flavorText: For two weeks, she meditated in silence, undisturbed as she peered into the endless, unfolding facets of the universe. No pathway lay unexplored, no stone left unturned. When she finally snapped from her fugue, she uttered a single word: "Woah."

face.name: 恋旧风潮
face.text: 将所有随从变形成为来自过去的随机传说随从。
face.flavorText: 风潮不改旧传说，相看恍如昨。

face.name: Wave of Nostalgia
face.text: Transform ALL minions into random Legendary ones from the past.
face.flavorText: Ja, please don't freeze my minions. No stall, ja????
